title: RC-01 Block/Mute Production Green Gate
purpose: Finite execution gate for Block/Mute. This is an evidence gate, not a new product audit.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI exposes all four operations with exact paths, auth, request/response and error contracts.
Actor identity comes only from the authenticated server principal; self-target and unauthorized scope are rejected.
Block and mute relationships use an authoritative uniqueness/state constraint and cannot duplicate under concurrent requests.
Account state and relationship state are enforced before mutation; blocked precedence is enforced server-side.
Affected authorization-sensitive private caches are invalidated or version-bumped after relationship mutation.
Blocked/unblocked/muted/unmuted events are emitted asynchronously after the authoritative write with bounded delivery.
IP/device/account/endpoint/target/global abuse controls execute before expensive writes where applicable.
Integration and security E2E prove idempotency, concurrency convergence, permission isolation and propagation to feed/search/message/notification surfaces.

greenRule: RC-01 is GREEN only when every requiredEvidence item is PASS and CI records the corresponding immutable evidence reference.
implementationBlocker: The current main branch does not expose a usable application src/ baseline. Domain implementation must not be fabricated against an unseen Payload codebase.
nextAction: Sync the current Payload application source to GitHub main (or provide the exact implementation branch). Then implement RC-01 against this frozen contract and execute the gate.
